{{Top}}
[[File:LAAT.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry]] transporting [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]]]
A '''troop transport''' was a vehicle or [[Starship/Legends|starship]] capable of ferrying [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] between locations.

Transports capable of ferrying [[Troop/Legends|troops]] through space included the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Victory-class Star Destroyer]], the [[Y-4 Transport|Y-4 Raptor]],<ref name="The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> the [[CR25 troop carrier/Legends|CR25 troop carrier]], the [[CR20 troop carrier/Legends|CR-20 troop carrier]], the [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|Sentinel-class landing craft]], the [[Galleon (Starship class)|Imperial Galleon]], and the [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle]].<ref name="Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> The [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] could be adapted to become a troop transport by adding sealed passenger pods.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels" /> The [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|Acclamator-class assault ship]] transported thousands of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] throughout the galaxy during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A variety of [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transports]] also served as clone trooper transports.<ref name="New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

Vehicles that transported troops across ground terrain included the [[Reconnaissance Troop Transporter|Imperial Troop Transporter]], a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] transport often used to ferry [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] troops. Other troop transport vehicles included the [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transport]] used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]],<ref name="Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia" /> and the [[Republic Troop Transport/Legends|Republic Troop Transport]]. Although mostly a combat [[Walker/Legends|walker]], the [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] also served to transport Imperial ground troops as well as other ground vehicles.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
The [[HAVw A5 Juggernaut]] was a massive wheeled combat vehicle mainly used as troop transport.<ref name="New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels" />

Underwater vessels that could transport troops included the [[Amphibion]], an aquatic assault vessel,<ref name="New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels" /> and the [[Ocean Troop Transport]].<ref name="Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia" />

The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] employed several troop transports to [[Last Stand at Refnar|evacuate]] the [[Unidentified Alliance base (Refnar)|Alliance base]] on [[Refnar]].
